missionPremise: Eleven domains are registered, generate deterministic fixture data, are served at GET /api/domains/<id>?cityKey=, and reach NO pixel. Ruling 1 (operator-approved 2026-08-19, OPS-17 A-081) says the four source states are four different customer sentences and that collapsing any pair re-creates the defect the ruling exists to close. Until a lens renders them, ruling 1 is implemented in src/fixture-seam.mjs and invisible to every customer. This lane makes two of the fifteen lenses show it.
completionPredicate: A stranger opens the served surface at /?lens=fleet and /?lens=public-works on template-city and sees generated records with their counting rules and their basis lines; opens the same two lenses on ?cityKey=empty-city and sees every region reachable, quiet, and stating WHY it is empty; and can be shown ungranted and granted-empty rendering as two visibly different sentences on the same regions. CI conclusion string is "success", the suite count has not fallen, axe on both themes on both surfaces adds zero nodes to color-contrast and zero to scrollable-region-focusable, and heading-order does not grow.
scopeBasis: The dispatch assigns exactly <section id="lens-fleet"> and <section id="lens-public-works"> in web/index.html plus the CSS those sections need in web/shell.css. Two sibling lanes hold Development services (R1) and Police / Fire and EMS (R2) in separate clones off the same main, so anything shared is touched append-only and anything owned by another lens is not touched at all. web/app.js is NOT named in the ownership sentence but is unavoidable: the composed payload reaches the browser only through a served script, and the dispatch's own instruction is to compose the existing seam onto the surface rather than to write a second data path. The app.js change is therefore one contiguous appended block reading the EXISTING /api/domains/ route, no new endpoint, no new generator, no fetch of anything the product does not already serve.

compositionPlan.dataPath: existing GET /api/domains/<domainId>?cityKey=<key> (src/server.mjs:271). No new route, no new generator, no second fixture path. cityKey comes from resolveStaffMapQuery, exactly as loadPipeline already does.

sharedRenderer.why: three regions, one four-state rule. Three copies of one rule is the CTRL-1 shape (DEV_PROCESS 2.4), so there is ONE renderer and the region identity is a prefix parameter.
sharedRenderer.idInventory: 3 prefixes x 9 slots = 27 ids, every one present in static markup. This is deliberate: the addressability gate resolves getElementById(`${prefix}-${slot}`) as an R4-through-R2 cross-product, so the cross-product IS the required set and a slot missing on one region fails the gate by name.

fourStatesAtThePixel.ok: state block hidden, records container shown, Demo records pill shown, provenance chip shown, caption carries the count WITH its counting rule, basis under the table is the payload's own basis
fourStatesAtThePixel.ungranted: kicker 'No source'. Head: no source is granted for the <region> region on <cityKey>. Basis: the payload's, which names the vendor and the pack.
fourStatesAtThePixel.granted-empty: kicker 'Source returned nothing'. Head: the source for <region> is granted on <cityKey> and returned no records. Basis: the payload's, which names the vendor and the pack and says it produced no records. DIFFERENT KICKER AND DIFFERENT HEAD from ungranted, which is the whole point of ruling 1.
fourStatesAtThePixel.no-fixture-source: kicker 'Not generating'. Head: <cityKey> generates no records, so the <region> region has nothing to show. Region stays reachable and quiet.
fourStatesAtThePixel.did-not-read: fifth branch, following the loadPipeline precedent: a failed read is NOT an empty city. Kicker 'Region did not read', with its own stated basis. An empty result is not an absence (AGENT_CONTRACT section 5).
fourStatesAtThePixel.everyHeadTextIsDerived: region and cityKey come from the payload. No vendor name, city name or freshness string is invented in app.js.

accessibilityPlan.headings: each lens keeps exactly one h1 and hidden lenses are display:none so axe sees one h1 per surface. The <h5> inside .state becomes <h2>, which is already a pinned ramp selector (.state h2, .state h5) so it needs no CSS. This REMOVES the 1 heading-order node each of my two surfaces carries today rather than adding to the 11.
accessibilityPlan.controls: this lane adds NO interactive control. Nothing to name, and nothing new that can be keyboard-trapped.
accessibilityPlan.scrollableRegions: .colstack carries overflow-y:auto, so a populated column becomes a scrollable region and would add to the 4 failing nodes. Every colstack this lane ships carries tabindex="0" plus role="region" plus a distinct aria-label. role is required because aria-label on a roleless div is itself an axe finding (aria-prohibited-attr), and the global :focus-visible outline in shell.css means the focus ring costs no CSS.
accessibilityPlan.contrast: no new colour. shell.css may declare no hex and no rgb() (type-conformance), so every surface uses tokens G-94 already raised to AA. Verified by re-running the scanner in BOTH themes, driving data-theme and asserting it landed.
accessibilityPlan.countingRule: before and after are the same instrument, same 16 targets, same tag set; a node is one failing DOM element on one surface.

No product code is added to make the states reachable, and no payload is hand-written.

CP1: Q: does composing the seam onto a lens create a second data path? A: no. The route already exists and is already tested; this lane adds a reader, not a source. A second path would be a client-side generator or a direct vendor fetch, and there is neither.

Q: could the four states collapse into three on the pixel? A: the failure mode is rendering payload.basis alone, since ungranted and granted-empty both carry a basis and would then differ only in a sentence a reader has to parse carefully. Guarded by giving each state its own KICKER and its own HEAD, and by pinning all four as distinct strings in a test rather than in prose.

Q: is 'Demo records' a second environment badge? A: no. It is the G-77 fixture marker already shipping on the DS pipeline panel head and pinned by ui.test.mjs:624. The environment badge is class .env and stays unique.

Q: does a metric strip showing counts contradict 'no bare confidence'? A: no confidence value is rendered anywhere; the payload carries none and the seam's FORBIDDEN_KEYS rejects one. Every count travels with the counting rule the generator wrote.

Q: what would make this lane look done and not be? A: rendering template-city only. The empty-city walk and the two unreachable states are the parts that prove ruling 1, so they are deliverables and not an appendix.
